description: Neighborhood sector bboxes for MAP-31A sector-aware footprint policy resolution. Lot sector is determined by lot center point (cx, cy) falling inside a bbox. First match wins. Unmatched lots fall back to DEFAULT.

sectors.tone_note: High-density mixed-use: tighter setbacks, higher coverage ratio
